Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGM):

Other Wearable & Tracking Options
Smartwatches & Wearables:
General consumer smartwatches and fitness bands that cover basic heart-rate or step tracking are typically found through broader department store electronics rather than specialized pharmacy medical stock.
ECG / Advanced Sleep Trackers:
Specialized clinical wearable ECG monitors or remote patient monitoring (RPM) telemetry setups are generally sourced via medical equipment suppliers or healthcare providers rather than over-the-counter at regional pharmacies.
